data.one_liner: Helper libraries for creating discoverable development services.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to create tooling announcement servers for development tools like niddler. It helps manage the lifecycle and announcement of discoverable development services.
use_when: You are building custom development tooling or debug services that need to be discoverable.
You are using or extending tooling similar to niddler.
avoid_when: You are building standard production features unrelated to local development tooling.
strengths: Simplifies creation of discoverable development services.
Supports announcement via the VM service for web compatibility.
weaknesses: Very niche use case focused solely on tooling developers.
Limited documentation outside of a basic usage example.
